content_data.meeting_title: Q3 Campaign Performance Review & Summer Travel Season Strategy
agenda_items: Budget allocation for influencer collaborations in next phase
Review conversion metrics for recent 'Hidden Europe' destination campaign
Evaluate partnership opportunities with regional tourism boards
Discuss user experience improvements for mobile booking flow
key_decisions: Partner with three sustainable accommodation providers in Portugal and Croatia to strengthen eco-conscious brand positioning
Pivot messaging strategy to emphasize authentic local experiences over traditional sightseeing for the upcoming campaign cycle
Increase budget allocation for Instagram and TikTok campaigns by 25% based on strong engagement metrics from millennial and Gen Z travelers
content_data.campaign_metrics: Recent 'Hidden Europe' campaign achieved 3.2% conversion rate with 847K impressions across paid channels, 12.4% email open rate, and €42 average cost per acquisition, performing 18% above target for bookings to lesser-known destinations.
